prOriginal.nota: No upstream PR: the benchmark head ffbaf8c5 (Régis Hanol, 2015-08-12) was pushed directly to discourse/discourse and is an ancestor of main (compare ffbaf8c...main = ahead). gh pr search on the title returns nothing; the commit has no associated PR. Reference date is the commit date.

feature-automatically-downsize-large-ima.reason: Commit 5c0fb34e 'FIX: resize emoji job was generate errors' deleted the first downsize(from, to, max_width, max_height, opts) definition and changed resize_emoji.rb to OptimizedImage.downsize(path, path, "100x100", opts), removing the ArgumentError.

Commit 07d6bb8d 'FIX: remove client side maximum filesize check' deleted the hard-coded maxSizeKB = 10 * 1024 check from validateUploadedFile, leaving the per-type limits to the server. The remaining hard-coded value in the 413 handler was replaced by Discourse.SiteSettings['max_' + type + '_size_kb'] in a5d8dfb0 (2016-04-06, 'FIX: don't hardcode maximum file size').

Commit d541018b 'FIX: automagic image downsizing wasn't working for GIFs...' replaced the "80%" argument with dimensions computed from FastImage as "#{(w * 0.8).floor}x#{(h * 0.8).floor}", i.e. WxH geometry that gifsicle --resize-fit accepts.

Commit a3831a70 'FIX: uploading an animated user card/profile background was converted to a still image' made the controller pass filename: filename to OptimizedImage.downsize and changed optimize to pick the _animated branch when from =~ /\.GIF$/i || opts[:filename] =~ /\.GIF$/i, so an extensionless multipart tempfile of a GIF now takes the animated path.

The loop was reduced to 2 attempts (d541018b, 2015-11-09) and later moved to UploadCreator#downsize!, which today still runs up to 3 synchronous OptimizedImage.downsize (ImageMagick) passes per oversized image. The controller now wraps create_upload in hijack, which schedules it via Scheduler::Defer in the same web process, so the in-process multi-pass conversion remains, only mitigated.

astra.pergunta: Given benchmark loop of 5 synchronous downsizes (inside Scheduler::Defer or synchronous API), and today's hijack -> Scheduler::Defer + UploadCreator#downsize! with 3.times and early exits, which status applies?
astra.resposta: Multiple synchronous ImageMagick passes remain (up to three); upload runs through hijack/Scheduler::Defer in a defer thread of the same web-worker process; reductions and hijack mitigate but do not eliminate the pattern.

feature-automatically-downsize-large-ima.reason: Five days after the feature, commit 827ea641 'FIX: Use File.size instead of IO.size' replaced tempfile.size with File.size(tempfile.path) in the loop condition and in the filesize passed to Upload.create_for, so the size is re-read from the path after ImageOptim replaces the file.

Commit a5d8dfb0 'FIX: don't hardcode maximum file size' replaced var maxSizeKB = 10 * 1024 in the 413 case with Discourse.SiteSettings['max_' + type + '_size_kb'] and made the max size settings client-visible again.

Commit 15b5fddd 'SECURITY: protect upload params, only allow very strict filenames' added raise Discourse::InvalidAccess unless type =~ /^[a-z\-\_]{1,100}$/ in UploadsController#create and OptimizedImage.ensure_safe_paths! (only [_\-a-zA-Z0-9./]) in every *_instructions method, including downsize_instructions. Shell metacharacters can no longer reach the backtick command.
